title: The Mountain Meadow After Snowmelt
short_teaser: High meadows may bloom quickly after snow recedes because the growing season is brief.
story: High meadows may bloom quickly after snow recedes because the growing season is brief. Readiness allows life to respond when a narrow window opens. Nature and place reveal timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of looking closely. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Readiness allows life to respond when a narrow window opens. Nature and place reveal timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of looking closely.
spark_application: Notice one natural pattern or place today and write what it suggests about your own pace. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
